Container.Name: beszel-hub
Container.Overview: Beszel is a lightweight, self-hosted server monitoring solution. The hub provides the web UI and backend — install it once, then add agents on each server you want to monitor.[br][br]After installation, go to Settings → Keys to get the SSH public key your agents will need.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Persistent storage for the hub database and configuration.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port for the Beszel web interface. Change the host side if 8090 is taken.
